verdict.rationale: Google ships a fully-featured official CLI with extensive documented capabilities (codebase editing, MCP, scripting, checkpointing, etc.), confirming the existence of an official agentic CLI. However, community evidence is sharply split: many users report severe agentic failures (infinite loops, botched file operations, poor context handling) and some posts suggest the tool has effectively been deprioritized/killed off internally, undermining confidence in it as a reliable agentic tool.
